prose: Jevcrawl is an open-source web crawler for AI agents in which a small decision model, not the agent's LLM, picks every link and passage, so the agent reads only what answers its question at a few cents per crawl. It avoids both reading everything a crawler fetches and letting the LLM choose each link, and installs as an MCP server with a Jev API key.
highlights: Small decision model chooses links and passages; no LLM in the crawl loop.
Aims to cut tokens and cost to a few cents per crawl.
Installs as an MCP server for Claude Code, Desktop and Cursor.
